budget_rationale: 3 independent seeds, 125 visits/train-scene, 3000 fixed steps; synthetic shared-GPU timing approx .6s/step; no DEV tuning of budget
checkpoint_selection: independent per variant/seed using same DEV rule; never best seed
context_roles: independent A/B states, equal loss weights
cpu_affinity_rationale: user-restricted to cores 8-23; before freezing, the statistics tests crashed natively in numpy 3/12 times unpinned and 0/12 times pinned to cores 8-23
execution: all 9 variant x seed runs trained concurrently on the shared GPU (user-approved parallel GPU use); identical contention for C0/C1/C2
initialize: from scratch with same per-seed Torch RNG; no B-final warm start
native_crash_policy: a signal-terminated run (negative return code) is moved to audit/failed_attempts with an incident record and rerun once from scratch with identical variant/seed/config; archived checkpoints and DEV curves are never used; a second native crash or any Python error stops the experiment
sampling: seeded scene permutation cycled; primary query slot cycles per scene visit; uniform with-replacement rays, identical indices for A/B and all variants
secondary_C2: RUN_SECONDARY_ABLATION_ONLY: FREE_SURFACE16 = C1 + .1 free-space; reported only as C1-C2; never primary, never in C0/C1 common masks, OBS regions or qualification gates
seed_handling: all3 equally weighted within scene; report each seed; no cherry-picking
thread_rationale: only environment with a passing full suite; a native numpy/torch segfault occurred with multithreaded numeric libraries
train_targets: TRAIN primary_query2 RGB+ray-distance depth; never carrier input
